instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to use the stimpak on himself (inject it into his own arm), but the page offers no verb for using an item — only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. None of the reachable end states matches either: Glitch already holds the stimpak, so a holder goal would not capture using it, and location or speech goals say nothing about jabbing it into his arm. Offering it to himself and accepting would just leave the item in his hands, not consume or use it.
